remarks: Gorgeous and elegant brick front Colonial has been beautifully remodeled and offers a plethora of extras! Newer bamboo flooring in foyer, dining room, kitchen and mudroom! Kitchen features center island with breakfast bar, newer appliances, 2 pantry's and bay windows with door to two awesome stamped concrete patios with awning! Bright great room with new plush off white carpeting, vaulted ceilings, skylights, gas fireplace and wet bar for entertaining! Multi purpose Mudroom with extra cabinetry and sink. First floor den/office with french doors, formal living room and dining room. 3 bedrooms and 2 beautifully remodeled bathrooms upstairs. You will love the spacious Primary suite!  Fantastic walk-in shower, jacuzzi tub, cathedral ceilings, double vanity plus TWO dream walk-in closets (12x8, 9x8) tandem! Full finished basement with 4th bedroom, full bath and exceptional entertainment space! Newer furnace, AC, whole house generator, tankless HWT, electric pet fence, underground sprinkler system, roof 13 yrs. Newer high grade epoxy covered front porch and hi grade epoxy flooring in finished 3 car garage with EV CHARGING station!  Home is surrounded by Beautiful Landscaping that you will appreciate while sitting on your large covered front porch!
